Can you compare your two most popular options and tell me which is better for me?
Two of our most popular games are Ark Nova ($79.99) and Watergate ($34.95).
Ark Nova is a deep, immersive strategy game for 1–4 players where you design and manage a modern zoo through hand management and tile placement, offering high replayability for longer gaming sessions.
Watergate is a tense, fast-paced 2-player political strategy game where one player acts as the Nixon administration and the other as the newspaper editor, ideal for a quicker, head-to-head tactical showdown.
If you are looking for a deep, sprawling strategy experience, Ark Nova is a fantastic choice. If you prefer a quick, highly engaging two-player battle on a sensible budget, Watergate is the better fit. Is there anything else I can help you with?
